title: Would You Rather? Junk Food vs Healthy Veggie Foods!
subtitle: Junk Food vs Healthy Veggies!
description:
Would you rather choose tasty junk food or super healthy vegetarian eats? 🍕🥦 Test your choices with 15 fun questions that start easy and get seriously tricky!

Perfect for kids, families, and game night fun. Play along, pause when needed, and keep score!

All choices are vegetarian-friendly!

Drop your score in the comments!

👍 Like | 🔔 Subscribe | 💬 Comment your answers below!

#WouldYouRather #FoodChallenge #Vegetarian #FamilyFriendly #KidsQuiz
intro: Hey hey hey everyone! Welcome back to the ultimate Would You Rather challenge — Vegetarian Food Edition! Today it is junk food versus healthy veggie foods! I am going to give you two choices and you have to pick one. Some are easy… but it gets tricky FAST! Grab a snack, grab a friend, and keep score. Are you ready? Let's go!

questions.question: Would you rather eat?
questions.explanation: Crispy, salty fries are a classic favorite everywhere! Though carrots are way better for you!

questions.question: Would you rather drink?
questions.explanation: Fresh orange juice is packed with vitamin C and natural sweetness — no sugar crash!

questions.question: Would you rather snack on?
questions.explanation: Chocolate is a sweet treat loved around the world — but apples keep the doctor away!

questions.question: Would you rather live on only?
questions.explanation: Healthy veggie foods give your body everything it needs to grow, thrive, and feel amazing!

fun_facts.text: Apples float in water because they are 25 percent air! That is why bobbing for apples actually works.
Carrots were originally purple! Farmers in the 17th century bred the orange ones we see everywhere today.
Dark chocolate contains antioxidants that can actually be good for your heart when eaten in small amounts!
Broccoli has more vitamin C per gram than oranges do! So broccoli is basically a superhero vegetable.
Bananas are technically berries according to botanists, but strawberries are not! Science is wild.

outro: And that is a wrap on Would You Rather — Vegetarian Food Edition! Did you go for tasty treats or healthy eats? Drop your score in the comments and be honest — no cheating! Smash that like button, hit subscribe, and I will see you in the next challenge. Bye!
